items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Often when we had the jazz musicians up here like Sarah Vaughan and all of them, they couldn't stand to hear these chords...

ctx.x: Johnny Garrett came to the Cafe as a valet for us, where he pushed the piano on and off. He learned a great deal while he was there and he went out with Sarah and helped make her Vaughan/great. He's a terrific man. He just watched and he learned through watching and he became a great manager. Through him and Sarah Vaughan's husband and the pianist, they really brought her out in good style to the public.
You know Johnny's the maitre de at a restaurant around here now? Rust Brown?
